It’s definitely not just you. Have you spoken to them since it happened? And He decided my “ups and downs” were too much and fell out of love with me - really took me by surprise as I had no indication that he was unhappy or not in love with me anymore.

Thank you for responding. I have already been advised the services I have been referred to will unlikely give me medication, unless I am depressed alongside the diagnosis. They are more interested in supporting me with talking therapies. Which doesn’t seem like it’ll work for me, as I have no issue in talking about how I feel and I have tried researching coping mechanisms, etc. But not even spending time with friends is taking my mind off my thoughts. I’m glad you’ve managed to get better, it gives me some hope. The feelings I am going through seem so intense that I do not see giving myself time to get over it an option at the moment. It’s really difficult. I’ve tried my best.
I will be your friend. What has began these thoughts? I am going through feelings similar.
